_comment: Store listing images. Edit copy and palettes here, not in generate.py.
_propositions: Both sets say the same six things in the same order. Only the capture differs, so a copy change means editing two entries, not two sets of images.

images.headline: Your home screen opens with a keyboard
images.sub: No swiping through pages of icons. Just type.

images.headline: Search anything. Apps, contacts, settings
images.sub: One field for everything on your device.

images.headline: Search inside apps, not just for them
images.sub: Set your own shortcuts: y for YouTube, m for Maps, w for Wikipedia.

images.headline: One field that knows what you typed
images.sub: A sum gets an answer, a link opens, 5m pasta starts a timer.

images.headline: Fewer icons means more room for widgets
images.sub: Tap the wallpaper to show them, tap again to hide.

images.headline: An ad-free browser with searchable history
images.sub: Every tab is one swipe from the home screen.
